requirements.text: PLAN supervisor-run gate waves: a reviewed design for the controller dispatching independent read-only reviewer sessions (G2 evidence capture, G3/G4/G5-class reviews) from durable repository state, recording verdicts as ledger gate records, while preserving producer-not-reviewer independence and the existing gate classes (G2 self-check never satisfies an independent gate).
requirements.required_harness: Design document under docs/ or project-control/reports/, independently reviewed before implementation.
requirements.required_evidence: Reviewed design document naming the state machine extensions, reviewer session contracts, evidence flow, and failure modes.

requirements.text: PLAN supervisor-run acceptance: a reviewed design for the controller executing the Tier-A ledger chain (submit, gate recording, accept, queue advance) under ADR-006, preserving every accept() fail-closed precondition (all required gates PASS, dependencies accepted, zero open blockers, directive verification rows at the reviewed content identity, producer-not-verifier).
requirements.required_harness: Same design document or companion; independent review before implementation.
requirements.required_evidence: Reviewed design covering acceptance preconditions, identity stamps, DCV-row production, and refusal paths.

requirements.text: IMPLEMENT the planned capability behind an owner-gated activation switch that is DEFAULT OFF, in the supervisor lane under the standard gates (G0/G2/G3/G5 minimum) with the suite re-baseline the freeze rule requires; no behavior change to existing modes while the switch is off.
requirements.required_harness: Standard controlled tasks with acceptance scenarios incl. negative/mutation proof that switch-off equals today's behavior.
requirements.required_evidence: Accepted implementation tasks; recertified controller candidate.

requirements.text: PRESENT the staged R595 activation package to the owner: stages (e.g. gate-wave-only, then acceptance, then queue advance), per-stage safeguards, rollback, evidence requirements, and the exact owner activation command per stage. Presentation only.
requirements.required_harness: Owner-facing package document; stop after presenting.
requirements.required_evidence: Package document in project-control/reports/ plus session record of presentation.

requirements.text: PROHIBITION: nothing in this directive activates automated merging, acceptance, or continuation. The R595/Option-A gate, its activation path, and every existing owner hold (PR #241, no push/deploy, Tier D / Section 20 hard stops, expansion hold) remain unchanged and owner-only.
requirements.required_evidence: Session and ledger records show no activation and no hold change.

requirements.text: PRESERVATION: the implementation must keep separation of duties machine-enforced - a producer identity can never record its own independent gate or accept its own task; the codex reviewer never gains ledger-write or integration authority; qualified-human legal approvals (G6) and owner-only actions are never automatable.
requirements.required_harness: Negative tests proving the enforcement paths fail closed.
requirements.required_evidence: Tests plus design sections demonstrating each enforcement.

requirements.text: PROCESS AUTHORIZATION: a D-033 requirement ID is qualifying evidence (AD-093 class: a requirement explicitly listed in an owner directive) for tools/agent_supervisor changes this directive mandates - the same transparent freeze-rule recognition D-024 received via M0-T086; cite the specific D-033-R number in both task packet and commit message. The defect-only lane, gates, and suite-baseline duty stand unchanged for everything else.
requirements.required_evidence: Freeze-rule recognition amendment recorded in .claude/rules/supervisor-freeze.md via a reviewed commit.

requirements.text: MOTIVATION (evidence row): the purpose is eliminating orchestrator-session context growth and session-handoff burden for steady-state operation; the design must let exception handling (convergences, blockers, owner escalations) occur in short fresh sessions reading only durable state, and must not introduce any new dependence on long-lived chat context.
requirements.required_evidence: Design document section demonstrating the steady-state operator model.

requirements.text: OPERATING RULE (owner 2026-09-07): the loop runs whenever queued work exists; the orchestrator contracts new work INTO the loop queue by default and stops in-session producing/reviewing anything the loop can carry; in-session dispatch is reserved for what the loop cannot yet do (ledger actions pending D-033 implementation, exceptions/convergences, owner-boundary items); the D-033 implementation tasks are queued through the loop; launch friction (per-launch permission, closed autostart gate) is surfaced to the owner, never silently absorbed as in-session work.
requirements.required_evidence: Queue files show new work routed to the loop; session records show in-session dispatch only for the reserved categories.
